title: 帮刘奶奶摘菜
target: saying a job is done (摘好了); thanking an elder
curriculumStatus: Beginner prototype; HSK level mapping and native-speaker review pending

nodes.zh: 太好了！这些菜送给你，回家做饭吧。
nodes.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zhèxiē cài sòng gěi nǐ, huí jiā zuò fàn ba.
nodes.en: Wonderful! These are for you, go home and cook.
nodes.speaker: liu

wrong.zh: 不对哦，我要三个西红柿和两根黄瓜。
wrong.pinyin: Bú duì o, wǒ yào sān ge xīhóngshì hé liǎng gēn huángguā.
wrong.en: Not quite, I want three tomatoes and two cucumbers.
wrong.speaker: liu
